website.note: Company describes itself as a consumer wellness / nutraceutical company.

ctgov.note: All 4 listed trials have lead sponsor 'CV Technologies' (a different Canadian entity, not CV Sciences) and are COMPLETED.

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: CV Sciences is a consumer wellness / hemp-derived CBD nutraceutical and plant-based food company (+PlusCBD, +PlusHLTH, Cultured Foods, Lunar Fox brands; 2,500 brick-and-mortar retail outlets). Its only drug-development asset is CVSI-007 (CBD + nicotine for smokeless tobacco addiction), which the 10-K (filed 2026-03-26) explicitly states 'has been dormant for several years' and that the company has 'curtailed further development' and the related patent-protection support. R&D expense was only $0.1M for FY2025. No active Phase 1/2/3 trial.

categories: Hemp-derived CBD consumer products (+PlusCBD softgels, tinctures, topicals, gummies, pet)

excluded_legacy_terminated.reason: Dormant for several years per FY2025 10-K; further development curtailed due to capital constraints; patent protection support also curtailed.
